const OUString& OPropertyMap::getNameByIndex(sal_Int32 _nIndex) const
    {
        std::map<sal_Int32, OUString>::const_iterator aIter = m_aPropertyMap.find(_nIndex);
        assert(aIter != m_aPropertyMap.end());
        return aIter->second;
    }
